paragraphs: Yonatan son of R' Chanina. See the entry Yonatan Shida.[^1]

notes.text: The heading was recorded as provisional. Bar is rendered “son of”; the father’s abbreviated title remains R'. Shida transliterates שידא without interpretation, and the pointer supplies no independent target genealogy.
